scope: Windows x86_64 native evaluator/profiles, actual CoreCLR and published Native AOT callbacks, and two-path Vulkan semantic player replay on one GPU.
limitations: Input contexts, chords, analog named actions, live rebinding UI and device-management APIs are outside this slice.
Named input is transient; derived gameplay state participates in native rollback and durable saves.
No physical keyboard/mouse/controller, audio, weapon-asset, animation, Linux gameplay, latency, throughput or frame-time qualification.
Native AOT libraries remain process-pinned; compatible reload is qualified only for CoreCLR.
Unchanged GameInput40/call1-80/services-epoch7 and bounded legacy prefixes do not grant undeclared callback features.
